security_invariant: Untrusted argument paths must never traverse or write shared built-in object prototypes.
attacker_controlled_source: Nested or dotted command-line argument keys parsed by minimist.
missing_or_incorrect_control: setKey follows every path segment without rejecting __proto__ or detaching inherited built-in prototype objects.
sensitive_operation: Assignment of the parsed argument value to a nested object key.
vulnerable_behavior: A crafted key path reaches Object.prototype or another built-in prototype and adds properties inherited by unrelated objects.
fixed_behavior: __proto__ segments are rejected and inherited built-in prototype containers are replaced with fresh local objects or arrays before assignment.
root_cause: The nested-key setter trusts attacker-controlled property segments and can traverse into shared JavaScript prototypes.
required_evidence: Trace a nested argument key into setKey.
Show traversal through __proto__ or an inherited constructor.
Show that the assignment affects objects outside the result.
refutation_checks: Check whether upstream parsing removes prototype-related keys.
Check whether all containers use null prototypes.
